# Filter the dataset to find rows where both 'compensation.o' and 'compensation.r' are 'cash'
cash_compensation_studies = df[(df['compensation.o'] == 'cash') & (df['compensation.r'] == 'cash')]

# Check the 'discipline' column for these studies
cash_compensation_studies['discipline'].unique()

# Count the frequency of cash compensation in each discipline for original and replication studies
cash_compensation_counts = df.groupby(['discipline', 'compensation.o']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
cash_compensation_counts['cash_ratio_o'] = cash_compensation_counts['cash'] / cash_compensation_counts.sum(axis=1)

cash_compensation_counts_r = df.groupby(['discipline', 'compensation.r']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
cash_compensation_counts_r['cash_ratio_r'] = cash_compensation_counts_r['cash'] / cash_compensation_counts_r.sum(axis=1)

cash_compensation_counts, cash_compensation_counts_r

from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Create contingency tables for original and replication compensation
contingency_table_o = pd.crosstab(df['discipline'], df['compensation.o'])
contingency_table_r = pd.crosstab(df['discipline'], df['compensation.r'])

# Perform chi-squared test for original compensation
chi2_o, p_o, dof_o, expected_o = chi2_contingency(contingency_table_o)

# Perform chi-squared test for replication compensation
chi2_r, p_r, dof_r, expected_r = chi2_contingency(contingency_table_r)

chi2_o, p_o, chi2_r, p_r
